stem: The 11 players on a cricket club team in Rawalpindi have a mean age of 24 years. The mean age of the 5 bowlers on the team is 21 years. What is the mean age, in years, of the other 6 players?
solution: Total age of all 11 players: \(11 \times 24 = 264\). Total age of the 5 bowlers: \(5 \times 21 = 105\).
Total age of the other 6 players: \(264 - 105 = 159\).
Mean age of the other 6 players: \(\frac{159}{6} = 26.5\).
verify:
m = Rational(11 * 24 - 5 * 21, 6)
assert m == Rational(53, 2)
assert all(Rational(s) == m for s in spr_answers)
